notes: Shanti Parva, Rajadharma (vulgate §53–§59, §67, §88; BORI CE 12.53–59, 12.67, 12.89) — Bhishma on his bed of arrows teaches Yudhishthira the duties of a king. Next morning Krishna and the five Pandavas return to Kurukshetra; by Krishna's grace Bhishma is free of pain and his mind is clear; Bhishma asks why Krishna does not teach the king himself, and Krishna says he wants Bhishma's fame to last as long as the earth; Yudhishthira hangs back in shame and fear of a curse; Bhishma says a kshatriya's duty is righteous battle, Yudhishthira touches his feet, and Bhishma tells him to ask without fear; the lessons: exertion is greater than fate and truth is a king's strength; care for the people as a mother for her child; without a king the strong swallow the weak like big fish eating little fish; take taxes gently like a bee taking honey; day after day Krishna and the Pandavas listen until sunset. Family-friendly: no gore, no wounds, no blood, no bodies; Bhishma serene on the golden arrow bed. Satyaki, Kripa and the gathered rishis are narrated only or absent. Krishna = Ep 04 lock (official series reference) on arrive, why, fear, listen and the poster — always the FIRST attached ref. Yudhishthira, Arjuna, Bhima = Ep 14/15 locks (via Ep 15); Nakula and Sahadeva = Ep 05 twins lock (one image, both twins); Bhishma = Ep 10 lock. Scene master kuru24 = byte copy of Ep 23 kuru23-master (no new scene master). One new group lock (pandavas24, generated from the four existing Pandava locks) so the two seven-figure plates (arrive, listen) stay within five refs.

krishna.face: Youthful divine adult, serene dark eyes, gentle half-smile — the official series Krishna is the Ep 04 lock (episodes/04-akshayapatra/stills/_locks/krishna.jpg; Avinash 2026-10-05): pale silvery dusty-blue skin, white U-tilak on the brow
krishna.hair: Long loose dark curls under a slim gold band with one peacock feather (not a tall crown)
krishna.costume: Saffron-yellow pitambar dhoti, crimson sash, jasmine-and-rose flower garland, gold jewelry; exactly two hands (never four-armed); Arjuna's charioteer in the war — here off the chariot on foot (arrive, why, fear, listen, poster), no reins — never a flute, never a bow, never a child

yudhishthira.face: Eldest Pandava, the new king, calm noble face, modest mustache; ashamed and afraid on `fear`, relieved on `bless`, at peace by `listen` — distinct from Arjuna (Ep 14/15 lock)
yudhishthira.hair: Dark hair, simple gold diadem (lighter than Arjuna's heavy crown); no peacock feather
yudhishthira.costume: Cream-white royal dhoti and cream angavastram, gold sash, gold armlets — no gold chest armor, no Gandiva, no flower garland

arjuna.face: Noble adult warrior, dark mustache, steady dark eyes, listening with respect — Ep 09 face via the Ep 14/15 lock
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti and angavastram, gold belt and armlets, quiver on back, Gandiva held low and unstrung — never flower garland, never peacock feather

bhima.face: Big, powerful second Pandava, broad noble face, full dark curled mustache, quiet and respectful at the bedside (Ep 14/15 lock, byte copy)
bhima.hair: Dark hair in a topknot with a gold warrior circlet — not Arjuna's crown
bhima.costume: Deep gold and leaf-green engraved armor, red sash, gold-decked mace resting head-down — never a child

nakula_sahadeva.face: Nakula and Sahadeva, the youngest Pandavas: near-identical handsome young twins, clean-shaven, gentle faces (Ep 05 twins lock, byte copy — one image showing both)
nakula_sahadeva.hair: Long black curly hair to the shoulders, a small gold ornament on the brow; no crowns
nakula_sahadeva.costume: Cream dhotis with saffron angavastram sashes over one shoulder, gold necklaces, armlets and bangles — no armor, no peacock feather

bhishma.face: Bhishma, the Kuru grandsire: ancient warrior, noble lined face, calm open eyes, long flowing white hair and full white warrior beard (Ep 10 lock, byte copy) — serene, free of pain, a teacher; clearly not Drona
bhishma.hair: Long white hair under a silver Kuru diadem
bhishma.costume: Silver-white engraved armor, pale cream dhoti; lying on the bed of upright golden arrows that holds him above the ground like a couch, his bow laid aside — no blood, no wounds, no arrow in face or chest; never saffron robes; never standing or fighting
